headline: Trump calls off Iran strikes, cites Hormuz-reopening deal; OPEC+ adds 188k b/d for September
gist: Trump halted planned weekend strikes on Iran after an outline deal including reopening the Strait of Hormuz; Iran disputes the account. Combined with OPEC+'s Aug 2 decision to add 188k b/d for Sept, WTI gapped down ~5.5% to $80.02 (day range $79.56-81.30), below VWAP $80.44, capped under 80.55-80.75 supply.

headline: FIIs end 4-month selling streak, net buy ₹20,200cr in July; Q1 beats led by Reliance, ICICI, Bajaj Finance
gist: FIIs turned net buyers in July (~₹20,200cr) after 4 months of selling; Friday cash-segment prints showed FII +₹277.5cr, DII +₹2,260.4cr. ~38-39 Nifty50 firms have reported Q1 FY27 earnings so far, 7.5-11% YoY growth vs ~5.7-7% estimates, beats led by Reliance, JSW Steel, ICICI Bank, Bajaj Finance, Axis Bank.

headline: MOFSL upgrades ICICI Bank, downgrades Infosys in latest Nifty FY27 earnings-preferred picks note
gist: Motilal Oswal named ICICI Bank among top Nifty picks alongside SBI, Bharti Airtel, M&M, Titan; downgraded Infosys, offsetting the upgrade in Nifty FY27 EPS math. RBI MPC meets Aug 3-5 (decision Wed), consensus expects hold at 5.25%.

headline: Fed held rates 3.50-3.75% with 3 hawkish dissents; USD firm, yet gold/silver bounce off Friday's slide
gist: Fed held Jul 29 with 3 dissents favoring a hike under new Chair Warsh; USD firm pressured metals into Friday's close (GC prior close $4,107, SI $57.79). Monday's Asia session shows both bouncing: GC=F $4,118.3 (+0.28%), day range $4,102.7-4,135.8; SI=F $58.39 (+1.05%), outperforming gold, day range $58.02-58.69.

headline: EIA storage builds +28 bcf, above 5-yr avg; record output and cooler weather cap nat-gas upside
gist: Week ended Jul 24: +28 bcf, working gas ~185 bcf above 5-yr avg. Lower-48 output at record 110.6 bcfd, LNG feedgas dipped to 17.2 bcfd on Freeport maintenance, cooler weather forecasts across central/eastern US. NG=F $2.756 (+0.33%), day range $2.718-2.775, near VWAP $2.76 — bearish fundamentals despite the small overnight uptick.

headline: UPDATE: Sensex +780pts to 78,750, Nifty tops 24,590 as crude-relief rally extends on Iran de-escalation
gist: Follow-through on the Trump-Iran/OPEC+ crude story: Nifty 24,592.25 (+0.86%, day range 24,515-24,602), Sensex 78,752.35 (+0.84%, range 78,497-78,895), Bank Nifty 57,833.25 (+0.99%). All three above VWAP, upper half of range. WTI 79.49 (-6.12%), still below VWAP 79.60. Gold 4,112.50 (+0.13%) and Silver 58.13 (+0.60%) both faded off session highs, now below VWAP.

headline: UPDATE: WTI extends slide to fresh session low $78.43 (-6.1%) as Iran-Hormuz de-escalation, OPEC+ Sept hike deepen demand-concern selling
gist: WTI printed a new session low of $78.43 (day range $78.43-81.30), below VWAP $79.76, extending the morning Iran/OPEC+ driven selloff as soft China demand data added pressure. Last $79.55.

headline: US ISM manufacturing PMI beats at 55.6% (est. 54.0%), best since 2022; factory jobs expand for first time in ~3 yrs
gist: Stronger-than-expected July ISM manufacturing print firmed the dollar and pulled gold/silver off session highs. Gold $4,092.60 (-0.35%, range $4,074.00-4,145.50), Silver $57.59 (-0.35%, range $56.71-58.88), both below VWAP.
